headline: India brings 84 percent of its gold reserves home from London because of trust issues
label: NEWS
caption:
India has brought the vast majority of its gold reserves back from London according to recent reports.

Firstpost reports that 84 percent of the country gold reserves are now stored domestically instead of abroad.

The move highlights changing financial strategies and a lack of trust in foreign storage facilities.
